HSCCA Board

Role of the Board

The Board is the main decision-making body of the Hampshire and the Solent Combined County Authority. It was formally constituted at the inaugural meeting of the Authority on 13 July 2026. It is currently made up of one councillor from each of the four constituent authorities with two representatives from Hampshire County Council. There will also be up to five non-constituent/associate members representing the business, community and voluntary sectors. Once elected the future Mayor will also be part of the membership.

Membership

The membership of the Board consists of:

Chair, Councillor Nick Adams-King

Vice-Chair, Councillor Jonathan Bacon

Councillor Steve Pitt

Councillor Sarah Bogle

HSCCA profile’s for the board members can be found here.
